title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: Cheon with H-prime semiprime walks and bucket matching

claims.statement: For uniform secret s in Z_r*, given T=[s]P0 and A_i=[s^i]P0 for i=1..n with n>=2^20: Cheon's d=2^20 reduction to z=s^d in the subgroup H of order m=(r-1)/2^20, solved by a baby-step/giant-step whose elements are products of two H-primes walked in increasing order, one batched incomplete affine addition per step, 192-bit parity y-key with the six mu6 candidates per match, records routed by three data-independent hops to 2^84 owner nodes and matched in a direct-mapped bucket table of 2^34 head slots per owner node (2^118 total) with a chained pool (baby side inserted in full before the giant side probes), each node capping its own comparisons at 1.01x the per-node mean and its slots at 64 records, per-node fixed work charged as an explicit 2^33 + 6 x 2^29 head-zeroing count plus 3 x 2^33 setup/flushes, candidate pairs capped at 2^44 (fail on exceeding), each candidate retaining its 192-bit key and copied to both generating nodes named by its chain ids, so recovery is one linear re-walk of each of its two chains by their own generating nodes (at most 4 matching steps per chain, the kept values of the giant chain sent to the baby chain's node, at most 96 scalar multiplications per candidate), then 20 square roots and a 2^11-scalar-multiplication root-of-unity search. Heuristic success 0.4055 under H1-H3, claimed 0.40. Total work W = 143931323757347673117106143191650796 reference units at C=2000, including lists, tables with walk overhead, all records, routing with relay work, matching, candidate forwarding, recovery, kept-value forwarding, status collection, node setup, Lemma 1 and output; log2 W = 116.7928639, the bound holds for every n >= 2^20. Peak memory 2^123.4615 bytes (exact itemised sum 14642327847092224222872902267723317248 B over all nodes at full allocation, asserted as an integer inequality), preprocessing at most 2^115.796 units (upward-rounded, integer-asserted as pre^10000 <= 2^1157960; included), no advice.

experiments.purpose: Mode ledger recomputes every size, cap, memory sum and the exact score from integers; mode ec runs Algorithm A end to end on a small j=0 curve (walks, bucket matching, key-retaining candidates, one linear re-walk per chain with duplicates processed in arrival order and the 4-step cap counted as a failure, six-candidate check, d-th root) and compares success, comparison counts, false and true matches and bucket occupancy with the model. Toy scale only, one process and no routing; it does not establish production cost or production success.
